verdict.rationale: pnpm has a dedicated CI/continuous-integration doc showing it auto-detects CI environments and switches to frozen-lockfile mode, requires no Node.js since it's a self-contained executable, can install the runtime itself, and respects packageManager fields for reproducible headless installs. Community reports corroborate strong CI performance and usage in automated pipelines. Missing for 10: no first-party GitHub Actions/CI provider integration examples or independent CI logs shown in evidence pack.
